items.titulo: Google November 2026 Core Update Has Completed Rolling Out - What Happened?
items.resumen: Google's November 2026 broad core update has officially completed rolling out. Google updated the Search Status Dashboard to document the rollout completed on November 24, 2026 at 9:03 am ET. The rollout took 14 days, and here is what we have documented about this update so far.

items.titulo: Healthcare Ads Are Coming To ChatGPT
items.resumen: As AI discoverability becomes a priority for more medical providers, WebMD Ignite's new offering will help them launch ads in ChatGPT. The post Healthcare Ads Are Coming To ChatGPT appeared first on AdExchanger .

items.titulo: Bing AI Generated Answer - Different From AI Overviews/Copilot Search
items.resumen: Microsoft Bing is testing a new flavor of AI-generated answers that are labeled "AI-Generated answer" and seem to be different from the Bing AI Overviews and Copilot Search boxes.

items.titulo: Google Business Profiles Appeals Simplified Into A Single Form
items.resumen: Google has updated the appeals form in Google Business Profiles to a single form, replacing the previous multi-step workflow. This makes the process of submitting an appeal faster and simpler.

items.titulo: Google: People Don't Just Want AI, They Want AI & The Web
items.resumen: Elizabeth Reid, VP of Search at Google, was interviewed again and in this interview, she said that Google sees that "people don't want purely AI, they want AI and the web." She then goes on to explain this with examples of how some websites are easily replaceable with AI, while others are not.

items.titulo: Google Burying Links Deeper Down In AI Overviews
items.resumen: New data show that Google is pushing links within AI Overviews further down in AI-generated responses. A few months ago, Google AI Overviews had their first inline link in the first third of the answer over 75% of the time; that is now down to about 50%.

items.titulo: Google Ads Book Appointment Conversion Goals
items.resumen: Google Ads has updated its About Partner bookings help document to now be About the Book Appointment conversion goal. "The Book Appointment conversion goal helps you measure and optimize campaigns to drive scheduled appointments, reservations, and service bookings," Google wrote.

items.titulo: Google Thanksgiving Easter Egg Will Turn You Into A Parade Balloon
items.resumen: If you search for Thanksgiving on Google Search, an AI Mode easter egg will show up at the bottom of the results asking you to "Join the parade." You can then upload a photo of yourself and Google AI Mode, not AI Overviews, will turn you into a Macy's Thanksgiving Day parade balloon.

items.titulo: BADBOX fakes 40bn TV ad requests a day as Black Friday budgets rise up to 30%
items.resumen: HUMAN exposed BADBOX 3.0, a TV box fraud faking 40bn ad requests a day, as buyers lifted Black Friday budgets and a study said 29% of Amazon deals were not.

items.titulo: Principal Media Or Unprincipled Media?
items.resumen: According to the ANA, nine in 10 marketers worry that principal media isn’t serving their best interests – and yet more than half of them bought it last year. It’s a head-scratcher, says Kamran Asghar, global CEO and co-founder of independent media agency Crossmedia, on this Thanksgiving episode of AdExchanger Talks. “Why we accept this is […] The post Principal Media Or Unprincipled Media? appeared first on AdExchanger .

items.titulo: OpenAI’s New Shopping Strategy; What Advertisers Are Thankful For
items.resumen: OpenAI's new changes to ChatGPT shopping; why Thanksgiving weekend is so big for advertisers; and ad dollars are still getting lost in the programmatic abyss The post OpenAI’s New Shopping Strategy; What Advertisers Are Thankful For appeared first on AdExchanger .

items.titulo: Character.ai's banker wins court approval for its $1.75m sale fee
items.resumen: Users' chats face a $10m bidder whose backer stays secret until at least a November 24 hearing. With the sale hearing now December 7-8, who will get the data?

items.titulo: New Google Business Profiles Controls For Appointments & Dinner Reservations
items.resumen: Google has added self-serve control to appointment bookings and dining reservations on your Google Business Profile. This is the same as what Google added for restaurant ordering services a month ago, and it now also works for appointment bookings and dining reservations.

items.titulo: Google's change to Chrome's AI agent feature breaks early testers' code
items.resumen: WebMCP lets websites give AI agents a menu of actions. A change in Chrome 160 stops some testers' code working; a stable version is due early 2027. What next?

items.titulo: HUMAN traces up to 40 billion fraudulent ad requests a day to cheap TV boxes
items.resumen: At peak, more than 4% of the connected TV traffic HUMAN monitors came from the scheme, posing as real apps. Why two takedowns left the box supply chain intact.

items.titulo: Amazon faces study saying 29% of 351 holiday 'deals' were no cheaper
items.resumen: UGG boots sold as a Cyber Monday deal cost 83% more than 27 days before the sale, in a test of 351 products. Amazon says 98% passed. Why do the counts differ?

items.titulo: Heineken campaign returned £2.92 per £1 invested, Mobsta says
items.resumen: Put 40% above a benchmark Mobsta does not name, the result anchors a tool that lets brands weight audience signals by goal. What does the £2.92 figure measure?

items.titulo: Plumbing, not intelligence: Index Exchange on what MCP means for buyers
items.resumen: For media buyers, a stalled deal is the example: an agent checks four bid-funnel points and a human approves a fix. Does Index Exchange run its own MCP server?

items.titulo: AI agents can now pay AWS Marketplace sellers per request, in dollars
items.resumen: Developers' agents get five-minute payment tokens and a $10,000 cap per payment, with Tavily among first sellers. How much AWS keeps per sale is not published.

items.titulo: Microsoft says its bidding upgrade started in summer, not November 18
items.resumen: Advertisers keep Max CPC through portfolio bidding, and five account-level conversions unlock conversion bids, Navah Hopkins says. What did each figure measure?

items.titulo: Semrush puts a number on the visits that begin with an AI answer
items.resumen: US and UK marketers get topic reports built on 29 billion keywords and 317 million AI prompts. Can a modeled estimate show what AI search visibility is worth?

items.titulo: Ad code is no shield: Google's back button spam rule hits the page
items.resumen: Pages reached from Discover or from social media now fall squarely under the June 15 rule, while app hand-offs do not. Where does that leave ad partners' code?

items.titulo: APG|SGA wins 193 more Zurich poster sites under five-year city licences
items.resumen: ShopVille's 23 faces under Zurich Main Station, 13 of them screens, also stay with the Swiss firm. Licences start in February 2027 and can be booked today.

items.titulo: Character.ai says blocking its $10m bidder a day before bids protects no one
items.resumen: Regulators, creditors and the US Trustee hold the New York fund's name in private. Today's hearing decides if a $10m floor lasts to the December 1 auction.

items.titulo: 80% of UK Black Friday shoppers buy from unfamiliar stores, Criteo finds
items.resumen: 42% of 10,500 shoppers would use an AI assistant to choose a gift, 40% are open to it. Criteo pairs that with a 1.5x AI conversion figure measured in February.

items.titulo: Lufthansa Group licenses Platform 195 software for 72-touchpoint ad network
items.resumen: Lounge screens move onto the new system for advertisers in December. Wi-Fi portal ads follow as 850 aircraft go online by 2029. Measurement is still unstated.

items.titulo: Big Tech's tax payments drop to 12.3% of profit, Fair Tax report finds
items.resumen: Meta now ranks worst of six US tech giants, and a UK group says Europe missed out on about $110bn of tax in a decade. Will the EU, the UK or Congress act on it?

items.titulo: Google documents 12 existing bots that ignore robots.txt
items.resumen: Code matching the old APIs-Google string misses a new semicolon, and its push requests skip robots.txt. Which bot renders pages for Google Ads quality checks?

items.titulo: Fewer yeses, no more noes: EU cookie consent falls to 65.2%
items.resumen: TAGGRS data on 17.4bn GA4 events: refusals fell to 12.6% while unrecorded choices rose to 9.7%. Is the missing consent a banner problem, not a visitor one?

items.titulo: Only 8% of managers can make seven core decisions alone, Enhancv finds
items.resumen: Just 7.8% of 65,838 US resumes show an executive title, reached after a median 10 years of work. Does a manager title still mark who signs off on spending?

items.titulo: Dining out would be the first cut for 29% of Americans, Edible poll finds
items.resumen: Just 5% would cut celebrations first, while 52% expect to spend less on dining out or takeout within a year. What the Harris survey of 2,003 adults cannot show.

items.titulo: Amazon blocks third-party Victoria's Secret sellers from November 26
items.resumen: Only accounts holding the Brand Representative role keep selling the lingerie brand. Removals spare Account Health, and the cutoff lands on Thanksgiving Day.

items.titulo: AWS's Garman says AI safety can't hang on an emergency brake
items.resumen: Agents should get their own identity type and no more access than the humans running them, the AWS chief writes a week before re:Invent. What does he leave out?

items.titulo: Google Search asks for the wallet, after the inbox and the photo album
items.resumen: Spending and card perks can now shape AI Mode answers for users who opt in, with Drive and Gemini chats to follow. Will the same data reach the ads beside them?

items.titulo: Three of five Google Photos holiday updates were already available
items.resumen: New today: 12 Remix templates and a people-and-pets filter for shared albums. Gemini, Collections and Fujifilm items predate it. Who can use the new tools?

items.titulo: Disney+ turns the Avengers: Doomsday trailer into a ticket counter
items.resumen: QR codes, phone alerts and Pause Ads send US subscribers to Fandango on TV, mobile and web. Can a streaming app now sell the night out as well as the night in?

items.titulo: DISH Media sells Sling TV ads through Nexxen to reach regional agencies
items.resumen: Live sports and TV series on DISH and Sling reach Nexxen's buyers, with metadata in the bidstream. Which signals that metadata carries is the open question.

items.titulo: Amazon agrees to buy Decart's AI chip software in a deal reported at $7.5bn
items.resumen: Decart's three co-founders are set to join Amazon's Trainium chip effort after Anthropic quit $6bn talks. Amazon discloses no price. What is it really buying?

items.titulo: YouTube adds 15 firms to its Creator Partnerships API
items.resumen: Traackr, GRIN, iKala and Cafe24 join the vendors brands use to reach YouTube's own creator audience data. Two of the 15 surfaced months ago - so what is new?

items.titulo: Platforms face fines up to 1% of global turnover under French press pay law
items.resumen: Arcom can set what platforms pay French publishers after three months of failed talks. Could a free licence in Meta's paused terms leave it nothing to price?

items.titulo: Pinterest sells feed and search ad space through Microsoft Advertising
items.resumen: Microsoft buyers can bid on home feed, search and related Pins in North America, Australia and New Zealand. Europe is left out for the second time in a month.

items.titulo: Half the homes Samba and OpenX reached online missed the TV ads
items.resumen: Lightest-viewing third of homes took 3% of linear TV impressions and nearly 30% of digital ones across 11 campaigns. Missing: spend, dates and a control group.

items.titulo: Texas no longer asks court to make Character.ai name its $10m buyer's backer
items.resumen: Eight limits on Texans' chats, minors' data and ad opt-outs survive the rewrite, which also joins 42 states and DC. Will the December sale order adopt them?

items.titulo: Google Documents Previously Undocumented Crawlers & Fetchers
items.resumen: Google has updated a few of its help documents to add what it calls "additional existing crawlers and user-triggered fetchers." The existing, previously undocumented, Google crawlers and fetchers include Google-analytics-postbacks, Google-Calendar-Importer, GoogleDocs, Google-Edu, pageburst, PlayStore-Google, AppEngine-Google, Google-Apps-Script, Google-Cloud-Tasks, GoogleImageProxy, Google Web Preview, and Chrome-Lighthouse.

items.titulo: Google: Connect Apps To Search In Return For Personal Responses
items.resumen: Robby Stein, VP of Product, Google Search, posted on the Google blog A more tailored Google Search that's uniquely yours. In short, he said he wants you to "connect more of your apps to Personal Intelligence" so that Google AI Mode can provide a "more tailored Google Search."

items.titulo: Custom Attribution Setup in Events Manager
items.resumen: You can now set up custom attribution… Meta announced custom attribution recently as a way to provide different options for how conversions are reported. If you use a third-party analytics partner, in particular, this could prove useful. How to Set It Up Within the Settings tab of Events Manager, you may see a new section...
